title: ℓ_2-closeness testing of finite distributions

problem.name: ℓ_2-closeness testing of finite distributions
problem.statement_latex: Given purified coherent sample-preparation oracles for $p,q$ on a finite set and their inverses, distinguish $p=q$ from $\|p-q\|_2\ge\varepsilon$. Complexity counts preparation-oracle queries.
